title: 込む and words with many meanings
summary: A word with many dictionary meanings usually has one concrete picture behind it. For 込む the picture is cramming something in.

blocks.text: Dictionaries sometimes list a dozen unrelated-looking meanings for one word. Almost always there is a single **concrete picture** and the rest are metaphors from it. Languages talk about abstract things with physical pictures: we speak of time "going forward" as if it were space. Learn the picture, and you can guess the meanings instead of memorizing them.
Cutting (**切る**) shows how it works. The same word covers cut paper, cut a conversation short, cut across a field, and sever a relationship. All of these are "cut".

**込む** has no exact English match. The kanji is 入 (go in) on a road, as if sliding in fast. So it means **to put in quickly, vigorously or in great quantity: to cram in**. On its own, 込んでいる means crowded, as in a lot of people crammed into one space. The same word can describe a complicated situation, as in many ideas crammed in.
As a helper on the い-stem
Put 込む after the い-stem of another verb and the picture adds "into, thoroughly, inwardly". You can see the building in a chain: 読み + 込む = 読み込む.
A compound is the い-stem plus 込む.

rows: jump into water, or into a conversation
be silent + keep it all in
load data; read thoroughly; read meaning into something

blocks.text: Two of them have a second meaning. 黙り込む is to fall silent and keep it all in. 思い can also mean love or desire (片思い is one-sided love), so 思い込む can mean to be in love, or to have your heart set on something: the wish is lodged in tightly. 読み込み中, "loading", on a screen comes from the same picture, with 中 meaning "in the middle of".

blocks.jp: 駅はとても込んでいた。
先生が来ると、教室は黙り込んだ。
blocks.en: When the teacher came, the classroom fell silent.

blocks.jp: （私は）彼が来ると思い込んでいた。
blocks.en: (I) was convinced that he would come.

blocks.jp: 彼は、いつか有名になると思い込んでいる。
blocks.en: He has his heart set on becoming famous someday.

blocks.jp: データを読み込み中です。

items: A many-meaning word usually has one concrete picture behind it.
**込む** = cram in: quickly, in quantity, thoroughly.
As a helper on the い-stem it adds "into, thoroughly, inwardly".
Guess a new 〜込む compound from the verb plus the cramming picture.

questions.instruction: What is the picture behind 込む?
options: To cram in, quickly or in great quantity
questions.note: 入 on a road: sliding in fast, so crammed in.

questions.instruction: What does 込んでいる describe?
questions.prompt: 今日のバスは込んでいる。
questions.note: Many people are crammed into one space.

questions.instruction: What happened?
questions.prompt: 子供がプールに飛び込んだ。
options: The child walked around the pool
The child jumped into the pool
questions.note: 飛び込む = jump + cram in: jump into.
questions.en: The child jumped into the pool.

questions.instruction: What does 黙り込む suggest?
questions.note: 黙る + 込む: keep it all inside, clam up.

questions.instruction: What does 思い込んでいた suggest?
questions.prompt: 私は彼が先生だと思い込んでいた。
questions.note: 思い + 込む: the idea is lodged in tightly.
questions.en: I was convinced he was a teacher.

questions.instruction: Which verb means "drill something into someone"?
questions.note: 教える + 込む: cram in by teaching.

questions.instruction: What does 中 mean in 読み込み中?
questions.prompt: 写真を読み込み中です。
options: In the middle of doing it
questions.note: 読み込み中 = in the middle of loading.

questions.instruction: Guess the meaning of 書き込む
questions.note: 書く + 込む: write into.

questions.instruction: Guess the meaning of 乗り込む
options: Get on board, go into a vehicle
questions.note: 乗る + 込む: ride into.

questions.instruction: What does 走り込む picture?
questions.prompt: 彼は急いで店に走り込んだ。
questions.note: 走り + 込む: run and cram in.
questions.en: He ran into the shop in a hurry.

questions.instruction: How is a 〜込む compound built?
questions.note: The い-stem of the verb joins 込む.

questions.instruction: What does 切る mean here?
questions.note: 切る: one picture, many cuts.

questions.instruction: What usually lies behind a many-meaning word?
options: A different word for each meaning
questions.note: Learn the picture and guess the meanings.

questions.instruction: What does 思い込んでいる mean here?
questions.prompt: あの子は一人で行くと思い込んでいる。
questions.note: 思い込む: convinced, often wrongly.
questions.en: That child is convinced he is going alone.

questions.instruction: What does the い-stem + 込む add to the verb?
questions.note: It adds the cramming picture: into, deeply, thoroughly.

questions.instruction: Tap the compound that adds 込む
questions.note: 教え + 込んだ: drilled in.
questions.en: The teacher drilled kanji into the students.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that means "stayed silent"
questions.note: 黙り込む = fall silent.
questions.en: He stayed silent and said nothing.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that means "loading"
questions.note: 読み込み is the cram-in picture for data; 中 means in the middle of it.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.prompt: The child jumped into the pool.
questions.note: 飛び込む: jump into.
questions.en: The child jumped into the pool.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.note: 走り込む: dash in.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.note: 込んでいる means crowded.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.prompt: I was convinced the shop was open.
questions.note: 思い込む: be convinced.
questions.en: I was convinced the shop was open.
